About

Engineer, designer and manager

I love solving user and engineering problems equally. Having a backend background helps me see the bigger picture and architect software as a whole. Designer and frontend background lets me focus on users, empathize with them, and deliver a beautiful and functional experience. Even though my skills are heavily on the frontend side I love all aspects of product development!

Currently I work as a frontend engineering lead at Infotech with 5 briliant developers. Together we take care of everything frontend, includding new and existing products (~10 apps), development of our internal design system and frontend strategy.

My aproach

I'm very passionate about what I do and deliver but at the same time I'm first to criticize my work and pivot if necessary. I'm focused on my craft, peace and quality. I emphatize with users and always try to solve their problems and achive business goals. I strongly believe that software is 50% about engineering and 50% about people and collaboration.

  • Software - perfect is an enemy of good, fail fast, iterate
  • Design - user centric, function over form yet beautiful
  • Frontend - light, accessible, close to platform
  • Leadership - deeply care, guide and drive results collectively.
  • Collaboration - full ownership of your work, influence others and accept their influence
